method: Independent JSNES CPU execution of the unmodified original MM5 ROM versus embedded VST CPU fixtures. Each MM5 instrument on all four voices: held changes at frames 20/50, repeated selection at 35, native release at 60, end at 90. Exact APU-write sequence and 17 voice RAM fields per frame. Other native game banks are covered by 1096 additional StudioCore mapping/audio tests; this is not a claim of analogue console waveform equivalence.
